objective: Increase qualified inbound enquiries for the advisory service.

decision.statement: Which change to the site’s proof and enquiry path would most increase qualified inbound enquiries this quarter?
evidence_required: How the firm’s stated track record compares against the qualified comparison set
How findable the firm is for a prospect who does not already know its name

audiences.name: Prospective clients evaluating advisors before a first call
Referral sources deciding whether to recommend the firm

exclusions: Existing client relationships, which are managed directly rather than through the site
